parsed.summary: The PR introduces a potential behavioral regression risk and lacks sufficient tests.

issues.description: The change may break existing behavior by modifying the internal state of the `vocabulary_` attribute without training.
There are no tests added to verify the new behavior of `get_feature_names` when `vocabulary` is provided but the vectorizer has not been trained.
